_: The filters: what may push a people into decline. A filter tests a level against a difficulty (the roll plus the level less the difficulty is the margin), and the margin decides overcome, scarred or declined. The simulation reads levels, diff, repeat, domain, wreckage and the trait table; the view reads the words.

filters: one row per filter: key; name (how the legends say it); levels tested (averaged); diff (the base difficulty); repeat if it can be faced more than once; domain (the research pushed while facing it); wreckage (what a decline does to the works of the fallen: destroy the share destroyed, leave the condition of the rest); what it is in the world; and what overcome, scarred and declined mean for it.
traits: how each trait changes each filter's difficulty: positive is harder.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

filters.name: the Atomic Age
filters.what: the power of the atom in the hands of a people that has just found it
filters.overcome: the bomb is built and not used, and the people is one after it
filters.scarred: an atomic war is fought and survived: the world is scarred and the atom is forbidden
filters.declined: the people burns itself out in an afternoon, or burns its world and never rises from the ash

filters.name: Overshoot
filters.what: a world spent faster than it renews, by a people grown past what the world can carry
filters.overcome: the people learns to live within its world
filters.scarred: the world is exhausted and the people lives poorer on it, under a stewardship creed
filters.declined: the people exhausts its world and starves on it

filters.name: Thinking Machines
filters.what: the thinking machines a people builds, and whether they stay its own
filters.overcome: the machines are aligned and think with their makers
filters.scarred: the machines are put down and forbidden
filters.declined: the machines consume their makers, and a machine people thinks on where they were

filters.name: the Distance
filters.what: the colonies of a people growing strange across the light years
filters.overcome: the colonies stay one people
filters.scarred: the colonies are held by force, under iron centralism
filters.declined: the colonies become strangers, then enemies, then silence, and the people draws in

filters.name: the Long Silence
filters.what: a people that has stopped dying, and what that does to a people that has also stopped being born
filters.overcome: the long lives are borne
filters.scarred: death is made a creed again
filters.declined: the people stops being born, and dwindles to a remnant

filters.name: Self-Replication
filters.what: machines that make more of themselves, let loose
filters.overcome: the swarm stays in hand and builds for its makers
filters.scarred: the swarm is put down and self-copying forbidden
filters.declined: the swarm eats its makers' worlds and the people flees or ends

filters.name: Stellar Engineering
filters.what: the engineering of a people's own star
filters.overcome: the star is worked and the people is stronger for it
filters.scarred: the star is damaged and the people fears it after
filters.declined: the star is broken and the people with it

filters.name: Mind Uploading
filters.what: the minds of a people copied out of their bodies into machines, and whether they come back out
filters.overcome: the people goes on in software, deathless and still itself
filters.scarred: the flesh is made sacred, and no mind is to leave its body
filters.declined: the people uploads into a paradise of its own making and does not come out

filters.name: Transcendence
filters.what: the leaving of the body and the world, by the whole of a people
filters.overcome: the people goes on as it was, wiser for the choice
filters.scarred: most of the people goes elsewhere and a few stay to mind the ruins
filters.declined: the people goes elsewhere, and is gone

filters.name: faster-than-light travel
filters.what: the first crossings through the state beneath
filters.overcome: the door is used and the people is not changed by it
filters.scarred: the door is used only in extremity, out of a dread of it
filters.declined: the door is used until something comes back through it

filters.name: the strain of war
filters.what: the strain of a long war on the people at home
filters.overcome: the war is borne
filters.scarred: the people revolts against its own war
filters.declined: the people falls to its own war

filters.name: Revolt
filters.what: a subject people rising against its masters
filters.overcome: the rising wins and the people is free
filters.scarred: the rising fails and the chains are remembered
filters.declined: the rising is crushed

filters.name: the Wars of Faith
filters.what: the wars of faith that follow doubt
filters.overcome: the churches settle with the state
filters.scarred: the church outranks the state after
filters.declined: the people fights over god until nothing is left to fight with

filters.name: the burning sky
filters.what: the sky burning: a gamma-ray burst, a supernova, a passing mass
filters.overcome: the burning is weathered
filters.scarred: the colonies are lost and the burning sky remembered
filters.declined: the people is sterilised where it stands

filters.name: the dying sun
filters.what: a people's own star failing under it
filters.overcome: the people leaves in time
filters.scarred: the people leaves late
filters.declined: the people dies with its star

filters.name: the Open Line
filters.what: the voice heard for the first time across any distance, and what else is on the line
filters.overcome: the line is held and the people speaks across the stars
filters.scarred: the other voices are heard and the line closed
filters.declined: the people hears what else is on the line, closes it, and forgets how to open it; or becomes one voice

filters.name: the Brood
filters.what: the flesh remade at will, and what a people that can be anything becomes
filters.overcome: the people masters its own flesh
filters.scarred: the flesh is remade badly, and the people carries what it was
filters.declined: the people breeds what eats it, or remakes itself once too often

filters.name: remote matter annihilation
filters.what: the ending of matter at any distance, in a people's own hands
filters.overcome: the weapon is held and not turned inward
filters.scarred: the weapon is turned inward once
filters.declined: the people unmakes its own world

filters.name: memetic engineering
filters.what: a thought that takes root in any mind, loose among the people that made it
filters.overcome: the chorus is held
filters.scarred: the people loses itself in its own chorus for a time
filters.declined: the people becomes the thought it was thinking

filters.name: precognition
filters.what: the knowledge of what is coming, and what a people does with it
filters.overcome: the sight is borne
filters.scarred: the people sees what is coming and sits down to wait for it
filters.declined: the people sees what is coming and sits down to wait for it, and it comes

filters.name: the Signal
filters.what: a transmitter's voice heard by a people that cannot stop listening
filters.overcome: the voice is heard and refused
filters.scarred: a cult of the signal takes the people
filters.declined: the people is changed by the voice, or listens until it is gone

filters.name: the waking
filters.what: something asleep near the people, woken by its neighbours
filters.overcome: the waking passes over
filters.scarred: the waking takes a world
filters.declined: the waking takes everything

filters.name: Ossification
filters.what: a people's ways setting hard, and whether it can remake itself
filters.overcome: a renaissance: the institutions remade and the people young again
filters.scarred: the people is set in its ways
filters.declined: the people hardens until nothing in it can bend, and shatters

filters.name: the Succession
filters.what: a people that followed one leader, left without them
filters.overcome: the succession holds, and the people goes on under the next
filters.scarred: the succession holds, but the realm is drawn in on its seat and frightened after
filters.declined: the succession fails: the heirs fight over the realm, or nobody holds it and a dark age follows

filters.name: the Vial
filters.what: the vial: a plague made on purpose and whether it stays in the vial
filters.overcome: the plague stays in the vial
filters.scarred: the plague gets out and the people learns a horror of the vial
filters.declined: the plague gets out and takes the people that made it
